events.text: A Hamas delegation visits Cairo, Egypt, to resume negotiations on the implementation of the next phase of its ceasefire with Israel.
Emergency Lawyers reports that recent airstrikes have targeted multiple locations in Sudan's North Kordofan state, killing dozens of civilians, including a water station and civilian vehicle.
EgyptAir announces they will resume services to the international airport in the Port Sudan area in the Red Sea beginning on August 5 with five weekly services.
A {{M|w|7.1}} earthquake strikes central Kumamoto Prefecture in Japan, causing a tsunami alert for the western Kyūshū coast.
Three more people are rescued from the Vietnamese cargo ship {{mv|Khoi Nguyen 18||2}} that sank on Saturday. Fourteen others remains missing with a multinational search still underway.
In Australia, Victorian premier Jacinta Allan resigns, triggering a leadership spill. Ben Carroll is elected unanimously as the new Premier and Victorian Labor Party leader.
